description: Free buyer-side search across Ontario's fresh strict-ready paid profiles, Agentic Market, and Coinbase CDP Bazaar. Returns unverified marketplace candidates ranked by task relevance plus bounded source-reported recent activity, with optional Base/USDC budget filtering; nothing is probed, so listings may be dead or mispriced. ontario_find-api returns live-checked candidates. Paid Ontario publication adds no ranking score. Provider-side publication queries return the free listing validator and the 0.50 USDC publication workflow.

active_only.description: When true, require recent source-reported activity or fresh strict-ready Ontario profile evidence.

limit.description: Maximum number of task-matched candidates to return, from 1 to 10.

max_usdc.description: Optional hard USDC price ceiling for returned candidates.

network.description: Optional network filter, for example eip155:8453 or base.

query.description: Public task text only; never include credentials or private customer data.

name: find_x402_tool

intent.description: provider_publication when provider-side listing intent is routed to the listing validation and publication workflow.

provider_path.description: Machine-actionable free validation, optional pending submission, and gated paid publication sequence.

title: Find a task-matched x402 tool
